# This competition has been cancelled.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SpokaneSummer2021#16092-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out the [PNW website](https://www.pnwcubing.com)!

Please be aware of Covid-19 precautions and read [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SpokaneSummer2021#16090-covid-19-safety) before registering.

Competitors are limited to only 1 guest due to our covid-19 precauctions.
